description: This file defines the HomeScreen component of a React Native mobile application, which displays categorized videos with loading, error, and empty states. It manages navigation to a detail screen upon video card selection.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Simulates a refresh by toggling the refreshing state with a delay.

methods.name: handleCardPress
methods.description: Navigates to the Detail screen with the selected video's ID.
